property_summary: After any call to the fallback with a value that is not exactly 10 ether, the call must revert; the mutant allows any value, so a call with value != 10 ether and block.number % 15 != 0 succeeds, changing the contract balance.
change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) statement, allowing any msg.value to trigger the logic.
